name: compile-format comparison
source: Authored miniature task records in cases/, frozen rubric.md and the illustrative source contract in test/fixtures/compile/document-example.source.xml.
condition: clarified-specification comparison: every format receives the same validated task record (identical semantic content), rendered by src/compile.ts

shortening.how: the XML rendering of a copy of the record with every requirement rationale blanked and context.facts removed (lib.js shortRecord); compared separately from the three formats, never pooled with them
shortening.label: orchestrator choice

executor.effortLabel: orchestrator choice: the repo's textJob default (src/forecast-worker.ts); the document names Fable 5.1 but no effort
executor.toolsLabel: agent choice: the smallest set that can do a file edit/creation task; no Bash, no network, no subagents
executor.permissionModeLabel: agent choice: --print cannot answer a permission prompt, so allowed tools run and anything else is denied; identical for every condition
executor.settingsLabel: agent choice, repo precedent: src/forecast-worker.ts passes the same --settings to its text job so the CLI cannot substitute a model
executor.extraFlagsLabel: agent choice: no MCP servers from the account's config; --tools restricts the tool set, --allowedTools pre-approves it
executor.outputRequirement: fixed by each record's outcome.deliverable; the harness adds no instruction of its own to the prompt
executor.timeoutLabel: agent choice: a run is killed after 10 minutes and recorded as status 'timeout' (excluded from completion, counted in the denominators)

invocation.template: claude --print --model fable --effort medium --output-format json --verbose --no-session-persistence --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep --tools Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep --strict-mcp-config --settings {"fallbackModel":[],"switchModelsOnFlag":false} --name "Entomatical eval <case> <format> <repeat>"
invocation.stdin: the rendered prompt, verbatim (no shell interpolation, no command-line length limit)
invocation.cwd: the fresh working directory of the run
invocation.env: process env stripped as in src/forecast-worker.ts environment() (CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY removed) plus CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR = the chosen account's folder
invocation.binary: %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\claude.exe on Windows when present, otherwise `claude` on PATH (same as src/forecast-worker.ts)

startingState: a fresh temp directory per run containing the case's fixture files, then `git init` and one commit (so file-unchanged can also be checked with git); the account's own CLAUDE.md under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, if any, is part of the starting state and its sha256 is recorded in the receipt
accountsLabel: to be chosen by the user; null until then. A live run needs --config-dir <folder> on the command line

cases.source: AUTHORED specifications (the document asks for the condition properties, not an importer of real sessions); each is a valid TaskRecord with status ready plus a fixture and a mechanical rubric
cases.sizeLabel: Authored corpus: 16 development and 8 held-out cases; a practical starting size, not a power calculation.
cases.splitRule: split is fixed per case in cases/<id>.json; any tuning of the renderers or the rubric may look at development cases only; held-out cases are graded once with the frozen rubric and reported separately
cases.coverage: each of the six document properties is covered by at least 3 cases, and by at least one case in each split (checked by validate.js)

repeats.closeRule: a per-case correct-completion difference of at most 1 requirement between the top two formats
repeats.label: orchestrator choice; report.js lists which cases qualify after the first pass

measures: see rubric.md (frozen); the unit for tokens is the repo's: input + cacheRead + cacheWrite + output from the CLI's result record
costJudgement: 'acceptable total cost' is the user's judgement; the report shows totals and never recommends on cost by itself

hashes.note: filled by run.js --dry-run into out/manifest-resolved.json; sha256 of rubric.md and of the cases directory so later tuning is detectable
